{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
duplicate_patients = df[df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)]['patient_id'].unique()
print("Duplicated patient_ids:", duplicate_patients[:10])  # Show first 10

# For each duplicated patient, check sample_seq values
df_duplicated = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicate_patients)]
df_duplicated_sorted = df_duplicated.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print("\nSample_seq values for a few duplicated patients:")
df_duplicated_sorted.groupby('patient_id').apply(lambda x: x['sample_seq'].tolist())"}
